data.one_liner: Android implementation of the camera plugin using the Camera2 library.
data.what_it_does: Provides the Android-specific implementation for the Flutter camera plugin, allowing developers to interact with device cameras. It supports features like image streaming, JPEG quality control, and video recording via the Camera2 library.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application targeting Android that requires camera preview, image capture, or video recording.
You are using the standard camera plugin and need to specify the Camera2-based implementation on Android.
avoid_when: You are building for platforms other than Android.
You prefer using the camera_android_camerax implementation instead of the Camera2 library version.
strengths: Built with the native Android Camera2 library.
Supports custom video output paths and JPEG compression control.
weaknesses: Video recording via MediaRecorder does not work properly on emulators.
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec.yaml and use path_provider for safe video recording paths to avoid Scoped Storage restrictions.

alternatives.name: camera_android_camerax
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use the CameraX library implementation on Android instead of Camera2.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your primary use case is specifically scanning QR or barcodes rather than general camera control.
